title: SegDebias: Test-Time Bias Mitigation for ViT-Based CLIP via Segmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot classification performance using Worst-Group Accuracy, Average Accuracy, and the performance Gap, as well as Attention-IoU metrics on the Waterbirds dataset to determine if models spuriously rely on environmental backgrounds (water vs. land) instead of the target objects.

Evaluating zero-shot classification performance using Worst-Group Accuracy, Average Accuracy, and the performance Gap, along with Attention-IoU on the CelebA dataset to assess whether models inappropriately rely on gender-specific facial features when predicting hair color across different demographic subgroups.
